mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior month compresses discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days regardless of other macro conditions.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines by at least 0.1% over the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 4.0% in a single month, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of months when UNRATE exceeds 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate a broad-based weakening in consumer demand, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS fails to predict negative 60-day returns in more than 55% of instances, as measured by a Rank IC below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During sustained industrial production growth (INDPRO > 105.0), supply chain resilience supports corporate profitability, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO exceeds 105.0.

mechanism_narrative: Positive quarterly real GDP growth (GDPC1) signals robust economic expansion that drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days regardless of other macro conditions.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of quarters when GDPC1 growth is positive.

mechanism_narrative: When year-over-year CPI inflation exceeds 3.0%, it signals persistent inflation that prompts Federal Reserve tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of months when CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A rising unemployment rate (UNRATE) combined with a stable or rising federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates labor market slowdown without monetary accommodation, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: labor market stress with tight monetary policy
failure_condition: The joint signal of UNRATE rising and FEDFUNDS stable/rising fails to predict negative 60-day returns in more than 55% of instances, as measured by a Rank IC below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During housing market booms (HOUST > 1400.0), strong residential construction activity boosts consumer confidence and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of months when HOUST exceeds 1400.0.
